correctness.rationale: For each k=2..10 the image of the Birkhoff polytope is the convex hull of its k! permutation X-rays in ambient unnormalized Euclidean coordinates. The k disjoint-support cyclic X-rays Z_j have squared norms h_j=(k-j)²+j². Active subset J_k is all shifts for k<=9 and excludes j=5 at k=10; positive w_j=(1-t_k/h_j)/2, t_k=(|J|-2)/(sum_J 1/h_j), yield barycentric center C and equal active squared distance R²=t+||C||². Weighted mean-squared-distance identity proves optimality and unique center once containment holds. Independently implemented exact rational weight construction and independent C++ integer-arithmetic enumeration of all permutations for every k=2..10: at k=10 all 3,628,800 permutations verified, exactly nine equality permutations and nine distinct X-rays; all noncontacts strictly inside (minimum positive scaled slack 4,274,850). Checked all 9 exact rational radii, notably R_10²=235064670/3593269. This finite EXHAUSTIVE certificate proves the entire stated finite range and claims nothing for k>=11.
